question.sql:
SELECT pl.drive_family, SUM(pe.units_completed) AS patties_plated
FROM seagate_core.seagate_production_lines pl
JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events pe ON pl.line_id = pe.work_order_id
WHERE pl.status = 'WARM'
GROUP BY pl.drive_family
LIMIT 100

SELECT spl.drive_family, SUM(spe.units_completed) AS total_patties_plated
FROM seagate_core.seagate_production_lines spl
JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events spe ON spl.line_id = spe.work_order_id
WHERE spl.status = 'WARM'
GROUP BY spl.drive_family
LIMIT 500

SELECT l.drive_family, SUM(e.units_completed) AS patties_plated
FROM seagate_core.seagate_production_lines l
JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events e ON l.line_id = e.work_order_id
WHERE l.status = 'WARM'
GROUP BY l.drive_family
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  seagate_production_lines.drive_family,
  COALESCE(SUM(seagate_production_events.units_completed), 0) AS finished_patties_from_idle_lines
FROM seagate_core.seagate_production_lines
LEFT JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events
  ON seagate_production_lines.line_id = seagate_production_events.work_order_id
WHERE seagate_production_lines.status = 'WARM'
GROUP BY seagate_production_lines.drive_family
LIMIT 100

SELECT p.drive_family, SUM(e.units_completed) AS finished_patties_count

question.sql:
SELECT sku.drive_family, SUM(ev.units_completed) AS plated_units
FROM seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus sku
JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_work_orders wo ON wo.sku_id = sku.sku_id
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_production_lines ln ON ln.line_id = wo.line_id
JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events ev ON ev.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id
WHERE ln.status = 'WARM'
GROUP BY sku.drive_family
LIMIT 100

JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events ev ON ev.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id
WHERE ln.status = 'WARM'
GROUP BY sku.drive_family
LIMIT 100

question.sql: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN sqt.result = 'PASS' AND sqt.garnish_defect = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*)) AS golden_yield FROM seagate_ops.seagate_quality_tests AS sqt JOIN seagate_core.seagate_production_lines AS spl ON sqt.work_order_id = spl.line_id JOIN seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus AS sds ON spl.drive_family = sds.drive_family WHERE sds.drive_family = 'Vantage' AND sqt.tested_at >= '2025-10-01' AND sqt.tested_at < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN sqt.result = 'PASS' AND sqt.garnish_defect = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*)) AS golden_yield FROM seagate_ops.seagate_quality_tests AS sqt JOIN seagate_core.seagate_production_lines AS spl ON sqt.work_order_id = spl.line_id JOIN seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus AS sds ON spl.drive_family = sds.drive_family WHERE sds.drive_family = 'Vantage' AND sqt.tested_at >= '2025-10-01' AND sqt.tested_at < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN result = 'Golden Yield' THEN 1 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS golden_yield
FROM seagate_ops.seagate_quality_tests q
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus s ON q.work_order_id = s.sku_id
WHERE s.drive_family = 'Vantage'
  AND q.tested_at >= '2025-10-01'
  AND q.tested_at < '2026-01-01'
LIMIT 1

paraphrase.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ev.units_completed, 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(ev.units_completed, 0) + COALESCE(ev.units_reworked, 0) + COALESCE(ev.units_scrapped, 0)), 0) AS golden_yield FROM seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus AS sku JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events AS ev ON ev.work_order_id = sku.sku_id WHERE sku.drive_family = 'Vantage' AND ev.event_date >= '2025-10-01' AND ev.event_date < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000

question.sql: SELECT SUM(ev.units_completed - ev.units_scrapped - ev.units_reworked) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ev.units_completed), 0) AS golden_yield FROM seagate_ops.seagate_production_events AS ev JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_work_orders AS wo ON wo.work_order_id = ev.work_order_id JOIN seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus AS sku ON sku.sku_id = wo.sku_id WHERE wo.ticket_type = 'STANDARD' AND sku.drive_family = 'Vantage' AND ev.event_date >= '2025-10-01' AND ev.event_date <= '2025-12-31' LIMIT 1000
